prompts.bike: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent game sprite atlas. Generate a NEW motorcycle rotation sheet using the attached motorcycle sheet as the identity reference, not as a layout to copy. Same black motorcycle, purple frame and tank accents, silver engine and forks, amber round headlamp, two mirrors, black tires, no rider. Camera fixed elevated isometric game camera, orthographic perspective. EXACTLY 128 complete separate motorcycles in a precise uniform 16-column by 8-row grid, row-major order. Canvas ideally 2048x1024 pixels (2:1). No text, numbers, arrows, labels, dividers, tiles, ground, or shadows. Genuine transparent background. Each cell contains exactly one entire motorcycle with generous transparent padding, no overlap between cells. All motorcycles share exactly the same world scale, camera elevation and lighting. Rotate clockwise through a full turn in 2.8125-degree increments: first cell rear view pointing north/up (rear tire closest to camera, headlamp facing away); cell 32 right-facing side view; cell 64 front view pointing down; cell 96 left side view. Final cell just before completing the turn. Each full row advances 45 degrees. Pixel-art inspired crisp detailed game illustration; retain original motorcycle identity. The wheels' ground contact midpoint must stay at the horizontal center and 86 percent down each cell. Keep all pixels inside their own cell; no opaque backdrop.
prompts.mounted: Use case: compositing, identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent production game sprite atlas. Input 1 is the EDIT TARGET: a motorcycle atlas with EXACTLY 128 motorcycles in a 16-column x 8-row grid. Input 2 is a CHARACTER IDENTITY REFERENCE only. Make the rider from input 2 sit realistically on EVERY one of the 128 motorcycles in input 1. Preserve all 128 motorcycles' exact positions, scale, silhouette, colors, direction sequence, fixed elevated orthographic/isometric camera, and 16x8 grid. DO NOT move any wheels or change a motorcycle angle. Match each rider to that cell's motorcycle facing direction. Rider: chibi post-apocalyptic survivor, weathered dark olive/taupe military helmet with a small pale medical cross, dark straight hair, black mask over nose and mouth, oversized olive jacket, brown backpack with leather straps and dangling rope coil, gloves, reinforced trousers and heavy boots. Sitting on saddle with hips on seat, hands firmly reaching grips, knees bent and feet resting on pegs, torso slightly forward. Correct rear, right-side, front, left-side and intermediate views. Integrate limbs with the motorcycle so no duplicate handlebars and no floating rider. Character same scale in all cells; complete combined bike plus rider fully visible inside each cell. Scale motorcycle+rider together down slightly INSIDE each original cell only if needed for helmet clearance, but preserve ground contact centers and same scale consistently. Crisp pixel-art inspired detailed sprite style matching reference, not photorealistic. No labels, arrows, numbers, grid lines, shadows, scenery or floor. Genuine transparent background. Keep canvas aspect 2:1 and exactly 16x8 evenly spaced cells.
prompts.survivor: Use case: precise-object-edit, identity-preserve. EDIT THE PROVIDED 128-CELL SHEET. Keep EXACTLY the current 16 columns by 8 rows layout and the current direction of EACH rider. In EVERY cell remove the motorcycle completely and put that SAME rider standing on both feet, carrying the same brown backpack with rope coil, keeping their head and body pointing in EXACTLY the same direction as their original motorcycle. Do NOT reorder or rotate any cell. The first row is back to rear-right; second row rear-right to right profile; third row right profile to front-right; fourth row front-right to almost frontal; fifth row frontal to front-left; sixth row front-left to left profile; seventh row left profile to rear-left; eighth row rear-left toward back. Correct face visibility: rows 3-6 (middle four rows, especially rows 4-5) must show the BLACK MASK AND FACE as the rider faces toward the camera, rows 1 and 8 predominantly show the BROWN BACKPACK. Preserve the exact survivor identity: oversized battered dark olive helmet with pale cross, black mask, dark hair, olive coat, brown backpack, gloves and boots. Stand upright, legs slightly apart, hands down. Full body head to boots, stable world scale and camera throughout. Each character stays inside its original cell with transparent padding, no overlap, feet midpoint at center and 90 percent cell height. Genuine transparent background. No motorcycle parts, props, ground, shadows, labels, grid lines, degree annotations or text. Keep 2:1 aspect 16x8 atlas. Crisp detailed chibi game sprite artwork.
